[FMLA 12] ParallelLRC — Impedance LRC Parallel

Parallel RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; the ROM uses 2πf, not a separate ω prompt.

Calculator scroll name: ParallelLRC. Parallel RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; do not type ω into the f prompt.

formula
Z1​=(R1​)2+(2πfC−2πfL1​)2​

In parallel the three parts share the same voltage. At resonance the L and C branches cancel, so very little current flows and Z looks large.

keys
FMLA→1→2

Primary inputs: f, R, L, C (frequency in Hz, not ω).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 2 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 1 → 2
  2. 50 EXE 2 EXE 0.07 EXE 25 EXP (−) 6 EXE
  3. Z = 1.99436 Ω
note

SI: f in Hz, L in H, C in F, R and Z in Ω (all > 0). The formula uses 2πf; there is no ω input.
